questions.question: Which sentence uses "derivative" and "innovative" with contrasting, correct connotation?
questions.explanation: See the Creativity lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: The design felt derivative, not truly innovative.
The design felt innovative, not truly derivative, so it was rejected.
